title: Supporting a colleague who is coming back
summary: For colleagues who covered, and for those welcoming someone back.
body: Handing work back is a transition for everyone. Agree what goes back when, and thank people who covered.
Share a short summary of what changed rather than expecting them to find out for themselves.
Do not assume how the person feels. Ask what would help.
If you covered extra work for a long time, you may feel tired too. It is fine to ask for a lighter period.
